entries.en: The delay put the driver in ill humour.
entries.zh: 延误让司机心情不好。

entries.en: Everyone waited for the big enchilada to approve the deal.
entries.zh: 大家都等着那位大人物批准交易。

entries.en: The comedy relies on a stereotypically oversexed main character.
entries.zh: 这部喜剧依靠一个刻板化的性欲过旺主角展开。

entries.en: The oversubscribed concert had a long waiting list.
entries.zh: 这场音乐会供不应求，候补名单很长。

entries.en: The illustration traces vessels of the lymphatic system.
entries.zh: 插图描绘了淋巴系统中的管道。

entries.en: The bank called the locally drawn and payable draft an inland bill.
entries.zh: 银行把这张在国内签发并付款的汇票称为国内汇票。

entries.en: A handmade bookmark was my favorite birthday gift.
entries.zh: 一枚手工书签是我最喜欢的生日礼物。

entries.en: The electronic bulletin board lets users leave public messages.
entries.zh: 电子公告板允许用户留下公开信息。

entries.en: A curtain ring caught on the damaged rail.
entries.zh: 一个窗帘环卡在损坏的轨道上了。

entries.en: The weather forecast predicts fog over the harbor.
entries.zh: 天气预报预测港口会有雾。

entries.en: The tree diagram branches from one common ancestor.
entries.zh: 这张树状图从一个共同祖先分支展开。
